t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Some colours earn more mushrooms than others and a gnome may be x5 but it changes depending on different rounds.

vb_textbox.text: The value of the gnomes change each time and tend to be unpredictable.  I chose dark colours for a round and done ok.  Earlier rounds blue got more than orange but last round orange was more.  Best to try your own logic and hopefully pick up a pattern. Good luck!
